newsitem.title: USA: Nat'l TechTeam off after big drop last wk.
newsitem.headline: Nat'l TechTeam off after big drop last wk.

text.p: National TechTeam Inc whose stock dropped almost six points last week, has dropped another four points to $11-7/8 in early trading Monday.
A Barrons article in Monday's edition noted that a brokerage had cut its "hold" on the Dearborn, Mich., supplier of call centers and computer services, to "underperform."
Barrons, whose latest issue was out Sunday, said repeated requests for an interview were "unavailing."
Following its stock halt at about 10:30 EDT, the company said it would issue a news release but it had not issued one as of early afternoon.

Barrons noted that National TechTeam's stock price had topped $30 last year from about $3.50 in 1995. It had earned $0.38 a share last year, up from $0.21 the year before and First Call had an analysts' consensus of $0.56 a share this year, $0.73 in 1998 and $0.80 in 1999, it added.

The spectacular success had brought Wall Street recognition to the company, but intense competition and the company's dependence on a few handful of big-name customers may be caveats that investors should consider, Barrons noted.
